name: set_runtime_mode
summary: Consumes one byte and calls sub_108693E0 with 0 when the byte is zero, otherwise 1.

name: conditional_angle_update
summary: For actor type +3 equal to 27, or 28/31, and selector byte zero, requires three helper predicates to return zero, computes a scaled angular value, and calls sub_10858E00. Other selectors/types only advance past the selector.

operands.meaning: selector; zero enables the conditional path

name: angle_threshold_branch
summary: Selector zero refreshes vectors, derives a threshold from the following byte, compares it with the absolute angular difference from sub_10855830, and advances through the 0x42 marker block on one side of the comparison. Selector one scans to the block terminator; other selectors advance one byte.

operands.meaning: threshold input when selector is zero

control_flow: handler returns a cursor; marker matching uses opcode 0x42 selectors 1/2

name: conditional_runtime_relation
summary: Selector zero continues into the 0x44 body only when runtime pointer +3172 is null or its +2040 word differs from the current +2040 word; then it skips/enters using the 0x44 marker. Selector one scans to the terminator.
domain_notes: +3172 = linked-actor pointer set by sub_108578A0 (array dword_1ED7AD2C, stride 3824, 40 entries), 0 = none

name: select_candidate_lane_by_flags
summary: Selector zero scans four global records, filters by active mask, current +2040, actor type +3, and a record flag, and writes the selected index to runtime +2612 (cmd_pl_target); candidates are ranked by the float lane values at runtime +2740 + 4*i (per-slot candidate weights). Otherwise it scans the 0x45 marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.
domain_notes: +2740 = per-slot f32 candidate weight; sub_10864A30 keeps the highest-weight slot among the qualifying ones

name: conditional_lane_pair
summary: Selector zero reads a two-byte pair and compares it with the selected lane record fields at offsets +20/+21; mismatch scans the 0x46 marker block. Selector one scans to its terminator.

name: clear_one_shot_flag_or_wait
summary: Selector zero clears runtime +2729 (linked-actor pointer) and returns immediately when it is nonzero; otherwise it scans the 0x47 marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: set_runtime_word_3228
summary: Stores operand byte 1 in runtime +3228 (delay ticks), or zero when the operand is zero.

name: set_action_context_from_lane
summary: Uses runtime +2612 (cmd_pl_target) to populate the current action fields. With no selected lane it sets type +2581 to 1, index +2582 to 0, and value +2584 to -1; otherwise it sets type 11, index to lane&15, and value to operand byte 1. It copies these fields into +3231/+3232/+3234.

operands.meaning: value when a lane is selected

name: lane_mask_gate
summary: Selector zero returns immediately when the selected lane bit is present in runtime +2684 (mode-reset flag byte) and the selected lane is not 0xff; otherwise it scans the 0x4a marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.
domain_notes: +2684 = flag byte cleared by sub_108693E0 when the actor mode returns to 0 (together with +2687 and the hate tables); its individual bits are set/cleared by sub_10854A60/10854B90/10854C70

name: clear_lane_value
summary: Consumes the opcode and clears the dword at runtime +2788 (hate table 1) + 4*(runtime +2612 (cmd_pl_target) & 0xf) when a lane is selected.

name: clear_lane_timer
summary: Consumes the opcode and clears the dword at runtime +2824 (hate table 2) + 4*(runtime +2612 (cmd_pl_target) & 0xf) when a lane is selected.

name: refresh_runtime_vectors
summary: Consumes the opcode and calls sub_108538B0 with the runtime object.

name: increase_runtime_value_2696
summary: Selector zero adds half of runtime +2708 (hate accumulator 4) to runtime +2696 (hate accumulator 1) and clamps it to +2708. Nonzero selectors only advance one byte.

name: increase_runtime_value_2700
summary: Selector zero adds half of runtime +2712 (hate accumulator 5) to runtime +2700 (hate accumulator 2), clamps it to +2712, and calls sub_10864790. Nonzero selectors only advance.

name: increase_runtime_value_2704
summary: Selector zero adds half of runtime +2716 (hate accumulator 6) to runtime +2704 (hate accumulator 3) and clamps it to +2716. Nonzero selectors only advance.

name: runtime_phase_gate
summary: Selector zero skips its body when runtime +1040 (entity status byte) equals 4; otherwise it scans the 0x51 marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: select_lane_priority_1
summary: Selector byte drives a candidate-lane search. It filters lanes using runtime +2687 (hate flags), +1826, +2040, +2824 and helper predicates, ranks candidates by per-lane float values at +2740, and writes the chosen lane to runtime +2612 (cmd_pl_target).
control_flow: returns handler result; no marker scan in this handler
domain_notes: +2740 = per-slot f32 candidate weight (sub_10864A30 keeps the highest one)
+1252 = per-actor class byte; sub_10864A30 compares (candidate[1252] ^ self[1252]) & 1 and rejects equal-bit pairs

name: select_lane_priority_2
summary: Performs a second candidate-lane search using active masks, matching +2040 and +1252 values, +2824 thresholds, per-lane +2740 ranking, and opcode-specific helper checks; writes the selected lane to runtime +2612 (cmd_pl_target).
control_flow: returns handler result; selection may reject all candidates
domain_notes: +2740 = per-slot f32 candidate weight (sub_10864D90 keeps the highest one)
+1252 = per-actor class byte compared as in sub_10864A30

name: lane_record_gate
summary: Selector zero returns immediately when the selected lane record is active, its +2042 byte is zero, and sub_10A94CE0 returns nonzero; otherwise it scans the 0x54 marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: lane_timer_gate
summary: Selector zero scans the 0x55 marker block when no lane is selected or when the selected lane's +2824 dword is below 30000. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: global_word_gate
summary: Selector zero reads a big-endian u16 operand and scans the 0x56 marker block when it differs from the word at global 0x1e8001ec+8. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: timed_marker_selection
summary: Uses selector-dependent marker scanning. Selector zero reads a count and big-endian u16 values, compares them with runtime +3185 (linked-actor pointer), and advances or stops at 0x57 markers; nonzero selectors repeatedly scan for selector 3 termination.

operands.meaning: selector-zero payload includes big-endian u16 entries

control_flow: handler cursor replacement; marker matching uses opcode 0x57 selectors 2/3

name: copy_parent_lane_context
summary: Sets action type +2581 to 1 and index +2582 to zero. If linked-actor pointer +3172 exists, copies its +1826 byte into +2584 and +2612; otherwise sets both to -1.
domain_notes: +3172 = linked-actor pointer set by sub_108578A0 (array dword_1ED7AD2C, stride 3824, 40 entries), 0 = none

name: runtime_flag_gate_3200
summary: Selector zero scans the 0x59 marker block only when runtime +3200 (linked-actor pointer) is zero; selector one scans to the terminator.

name: lane_value_gate
summary: Selector zero reads one value and, when the saved action type (+3231) is 11 or 1 and a lane is selected, returns immediately if the value equals sub_1086A530(lane +2040, lane +2008); otherwise it scans the 0x5a marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: clear_lane_words_by_mask
summary: For selector byte zero, clears each word at runtime +2688 (hate value) + 2*i when the corresponding lane bit is not set in runtime +2684 (mode-reset flag byte). Nonzero selector bytes perform no writes.
domain_notes: +2684 = flag byte cleared by sub_108693E0 when the actor mode returns to 0 (together with +2687 and the hate tables); its individual bits are set/cleared by sub_10854A60/10854B90/10854C70

name: world_position_gate
summary: Selector zero returns immediately when runtime +2040 (act/motion id) equals global +20 and sub_108CF5B0(runtime +172 (position x), ...) succeeds; otherwise it scans the 0x5c marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: vector_initialized_gate
summary: Selector zero refreshes vectors, returns when runtime float fields +2852/+2856/+2860 are all nonzero, otherwise calls nullsub_2 and scans the 0x5d marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.
domain_notes: +2852/+2856/+2860 = the stored reference point (f32 x/y/z) consumed by the distance gates

name: species_value_gate
summary: Selector zero compares an operand byte with sub_1086A530(runtime +2040 (act/motion id), runtime +2008). It also has special handling for table values 365, 367, and 369; otherwise it scans the 0x5e marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: select_lane_by_species
summary: Selector byte drives a lane search filtered by runtime +2687 (hate flags), active records, matching +2040, and helper classification. It applies special table checks and ranks candidates by +2740 or +2824 values before writing runtime +2612 (cmd_pl_target).
control_flow: returns handler result; no marker scan in this handler
domain_notes: +2740 = per-slot f32 candidate weight used to rank the selected slots

name: global_flag_gate_9466
summary: Selector zero scans the 0x60 marker block only when global byte 0x1e7fff3c+9466 is zero; selector one scans to the terminator.

name: resolve_event_table_value
summary: Consumes the opcode and calls sub_1085C170 with a pointer selected from global table 0x118c7308 by runtime byte +3. The decompiler shows a write to +2912 from an uninitialized temporary; that write is retained only as an unverified artifact.
writes: possible runtime +2912 write is decompiler artifact; not confirmed

name: conditional_marker_98_gate
summary: Selector zero skips a two-byte payload and repeatedly scans opcode 0x62/0x98 markers according to helper-derived selector values; selectors 1–3 scan to a 0x62 terminator.
control_flow: handler cursor replacement; nested marker scan

name: runtime_bitmask_gate
summary: Selector zero reads a mask byte and scans the 0x63 marker block when (mask & runtime byte +27) is zero. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: lane_threshold_gate
summary: Selector zero reads an index byte and scans the 0x64 marker block when no lane is selected or lane timer dword +2824 is below global threshold table 0x11a4bfb0[index]. Selector one scans to the terminator.
domain_notes: 0x11A4BFB0 holds the constant 10000, the act-id base offset that follows the 15-entry kind-name table (EM_EXC then KIND_NOT..KIND_EMY)

name: clear_lane_timers
summary: Consumes the opcode and clears four consecutive dwords at runtime +2824 (hate table 2), +2828, +2832, and +2836.

name: all_records_empty_gate
summary: Selector zero scans the 0x66 marker block only when every record in the global record set is empty; selector one scans to the terminator.

name: runtime_flag_2739_gate
summary: Selector zero returns immediately when runtime +2739 (command mode flag) is zero; otherwise it scans the 0x67 marker block. Selector one scans to the terminator.

name: request_runtime_refresh
summary: Consumes the opcode; if runtime +2739 (command mode flag) and +2659 are both zero it sets +2659 to 2, sets +2622 to 1, and calls sub_10860430.

name: short_angle_threshold_branch
summary: Selector zero refreshes vectors, computes a scaled threshold from the next byte, compares it to the absolute angular difference, and branches through 0x69 markers; it additionally requires the threshold to be below 0x4000. Selector one scans to the terminator.
